patient visit history

To view a patient's visit history, you need to click the 'History' button from the OP service billing screen. This action will bring up a form specifically designed for viewing the patient's visit history.

c scan

The 'CScan' function in the OP billing service is specifically designed to scan cards submitted by patients, such as insurance cards. Users can access this feature by clicking the 'CScan' button from the OP service billing screen. To utilize the CScan, the user must enter a file number, which can be done manually by typing in digits (excluding zero) and pressing the enter key, allowing the system to automatically fill in the remaining characters. This functionality is part of a broader system that allows for the management of patient documents and billing processes, ensuring that all necessary patient information is accurately captured and processed.

![CScan op billing service](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114401.png)

Privilege Card

The Privilege Card form is designed to display available privilege cards and their utilization details. Users can filter and search for cards based on various criteria such as membership number, document number, policy number, and mobile number, which aids in the efficient tracking and management of privilege card activities. To access this feature, users can click the ‘Prv. Card’ button from the OP service billing screen, where all available privilege cards associated with a patient will be shown along with their utilization details. Users can double-click on a card to view its utilization specifics. It is important to note that certain fields in the form are mandatory, indicated by red coloring, which must be filled out for proper functionality.
